news.analysis: Lawrence could have had a much better day, and the game's outcome would have been different had an end-zone throw to Parker Washington been ruled a catch rather than an incompletion. The controversial play saw Washington bobble a pass before appearing to secure it and getting feet in bounds for a touchdown, but it was ruled incomplete. Still, Lawrence had his faults and seemed to succumb to the Giants' pass rush. He will look to have a better outing when he faces the Titans next Sunday.
